status: source-only definitions; not a deployed semantic model, operational employment rule, or approved financial valuation

governance.change_policy: meaning, grain, population, unit, source authority, time and suppression changes require reviewed major/metric revision; measure compatibility tests and consuming-module signoff

metrics.label: Approved planned ordinary hours
metrics.numerator: sum of ordinary-hour allocations in approved effective plans, counting each valid allocation once
metrics.denominator: not used for scalar value; external contracted ordinary-hours reference is a separate comparison metric
metrics.value_semantics: sum, equal to numerator where reported
metrics.eligible_population: count of source-qualified effective plans in scope under population rule; not staff headcount
metrics.missing_count: count of eligible plan references without a verified complete record at refresh as_of
exclusions: on-call/recall hours unless an approved policy explicitly defines ordinary inclusion
metrics.disclosure: approved aggregation by service/period with suppressed small or inferential cells; no practitioner-level export
metrics.uncertainty: label partial or unverified extracts and rule-version mismatch

metrics.label: Scenario-estimated planned cost
metrics.source_authority: MJP approved planned hours + independently sourced authorised price/cost assumptions
metrics.numerator: scenario valuation of approved planned hours using named external salary/award cost assumptions
metrics.value_semantics: currency cost estimate, not actual payroll expenditure
metrics.eligible_population: service/period eligible plans under scenario rules, not payroll records
metrics.missing_count: must be quality-labelled at both job-plan and cost source boundaries
metrics.disclosure: no individual salary or clinical plans unless explicitly authorised elsewhere
metrics.uncertainty: source completeness, price year, salary/award assumptions and FTE status tracked

change_control: This is a candidate dictionary. Each module owns implementation, approval, RLS and native metric parity separately. Do not modify existing Workforce BI's 66-feed semantic model in this planning PR.
